thermal_scenarios.policy: 0.92A is a short burst allocation, not permitted continuous current. Normal one selected RF logic port, WiFi/BLE off, LoRa TX off-slot. Measure thermal/ripple before extending budget.

USB.supply_path: USB -> TPS2553 -> STPS1L30A -> buck. BZT52H-B5V1 bounds reverse leakage into USB_LIMIT. No intended USB-to-pack path; pack-present hardware inhibits USB-only RF.
USB.clamp_status: Differential-resistance extrapolation/thermal scenario, not a guaranteed DC clamp curve. Power-only hot reverse-leak test before normal use.
USB.VBUS_sense: GPIO37 inverted Q2 collector; firmware USB PHY detaches when VBUS absent. RTC INT unused, hundredths/time polled over I2C.

reverse_leakage_presence.D4: S1M low leakage; Schottky not used
reverse_leakage_presence.status: calculated component-bound scenario, hot leakage bench gate remains

endurance: Controller-only incremental model. RF module input energy must be measured over selected duty. 12h/24h full system NOT_RUN.
